name: ui-select
description: Select — UI factory (1:1 with the @almadar/ui select pattern).

schema.description: Select — UI factory (1:1 with the @almadar/ui select pattern).
schema.name: ui-select

action.description: Declarative event name for trait dispatch — emits `{ value }` on selection commit (same gestures as `onChange`).
action.label: Action

className.description: Additional CSS classes applied to the root element.
className.label: Class Name

clearable.description: Show a clear button when a value is selected.
clearable.label: Clearable

groups.description: Grouped options — rendered as <optgroup> in native mode, sections in rich mode.
groups.label: Groups

multiple.description: Allow selecting multiple values — activates the rich dropdown.
multiple.label: Multiple

onChange.description: onChange handler (native ChangeEvent) or declarative event key for trait dispatch
onChange.label: On Change

onValueChange.description: Value-based change: a React callback (internal use) OR a declarative event key that emits `{ value }` on the bus (render-ui / lolo authoring). Mirrors the `onChange` handler|event convention so it's an event-emitting prop, not a bare callback.
onValueChange.label: On Value Change

searchable.description: Show a search input inside the dropdown — activates the rich dropdown.
searchable.label: Searchable

value.description: Current value (string for single, string[] for multiple)
value.label: Value

emits.description: Declarative event name for trait dispatch — emits `{ value }` on selection commit (same gestures as `onChange`).
